diffs.diff: minimum supply: part 1.7 V, datasheet reading 2.7 V
diffs.evidence: The model describes the Microchip/Atmel AT24C256C. Its datasheet (Atmel-8568) states on page 1 'VCC = 1.7V to 5.5V', in the description 'operates from 1.7V to 5.5V', and in the DC characteristics table 'VCC1 Supply Voltage 1.7 (min) 5.5 (max) V' (TA = -40 to +85 C); ordering code 'L = 1.7V to 5.5V'. The 2.7 V figure matches the older non-C AT24C256 '-2.7' speed grade, not the AT24C256C the model cites. With 3.3 V recommended in the model, either is satisfied.
